map.name: Five Nights at Z Village Level 1
map.testedVersion: Static source audit only; runtime not executed

bugs.title: Reconnect during cinematic can carry stale coins into a fresh session
bugs.problem: A player who misses the cinematic inventory reset can reconnect and keep old coin currency, giving the new match an incorrect starting economy.
bugs.expected: Every new-session participant has stale inventory and currency cleared regardless of disconnect or reconnect timing.
bugs.observed: The cinematic clear only affects online players, and later kit reconciliation intentionally preserves daigon:coin.
reproduction: Have a party member carry one or more daigon:coin items before starting a new session.
Start the arena and disconnect that player while arena loading is still running.
Reconnect after loading completes while the intro cinematic is active.
Confirm the old coin stack is still available when gameplay begins.
bugs.aiAnalysis: Arena loading hands only currently online players to prepareCinematicPlayers, where the full clear occurs. A reconnect during the cinematic misses that reset. Gameplay later reapplies the kit, but its inventory cleanup deliberately excludes daigon:coin, so stale currency survives.

relevantCode.reason: Contain ArenaLoading completion, cinematic player reset, reconnect reconciliation, and kit cleanup that preserves coins.

bugs.suggestedFix: Track completion of the fresh-session reset per participant and replay it on reconnect before cinematic or gameplay continuation.
mustPreserve: Normal mid-session kit reapplication may continue preserving coins when no fresh-session reset is required.
